answer: Knoll escrow queue: every new identity locks 2,500 POA in the Ferrous vault for six full epochs before it can earn anything, and the lock is released only after the identity completes verified work in three separate epochs. A Dawn credit is issued per completed epoch and cannot be transferred or sold. Faking 2,000 agents means locking 5,000,000 POA for six epochs with zero return until work is proven, while one honest agent locks a single 2,500 POA stake once.
